title: Wax Castle Parade and Longboat Racing Festival2026 — relevant programme and Extended Exhibition
capturedBy: Codex native IAB visible text, programme and Extended Exhibition sections;29 October2026; relevant excerpt, not whole page
text:
October 23–24, 2026: Longboat Racing Competition for the Royal Cup at Nong Han Lake.
October 25, 2026: 5:00 PM: Wax Castle Parade launch featuring light & sound shows at the Clock Tower Intersection. 7:30 PM: Wax Castle Offering Ceremony at Wat Phra That Choeng Chum Worawihan.
Extended Exhibition: From October 26 – November 27, 2026, visitors can enjoy the special showcase Wax Castles: On Display All Month at Wat Phra That Choeng Chum Worawihan and participating local community temples.
Event schedule and details are subject to change. Please stay tuned for official updates.
